# FLAGS AND COATS OF ARMS, written in the language of flags.js (described in flags.html, which shows them all).
# `CODE Name: definition`, one per line; a line that starts with a space continues the one before; # and a space start a comment.
# Codes are the map's own: ISO 3166-1 for countries and dependencies (FR), ISO 3166-2 for states (DE-BY); CODE-arms is a
# country's or a state's coat of arms; lower-case codes are parts that others use (@castile). The flags are their simplest versions:
# lettering only where it is the flag (Saudi Arabia's, Iraq's: as strokes of a pen), and an emblem as a plain shape where that tells
# the flag apart -- or traced from the flag's own drawing, colour by colour, where it would be wrong otherwise (Fiji, Moldova, Portugal). Colours are by name (flags.js
# COLORS: each the usual shade on flags, near enough), not by code.
